name: Sunnyglade
summary: Twilight's Hammer zealots now occupy Sunnyglade's ruins in the Riverglades. Once a wealthy human settlement under Stormwind, it was devastated during the First War and abandoned as the Horde advanced.

sections.title: Fall of a Golden Town
sections.body:
Before the First War, Sunnyglade was a wealthy human town. Then the Old Horde invasion shattered its peace. Orc raiders attacked and enslaved the residents who survived. Only a wizard's tower remained intact, for human conjurers to study the arcane arts.

Stormwind forces tried to free the captive peasants and rebuild Sunnyglade. But the Horde kept advancing through the Riverglades. Stormwind's commanders judged the outer province lost and drew resources back to defend the homeland. The town was left in ruins.

sections.title: A Blighted Refuge
sections.body: Sunnyglade lies far beyond the safe borders of Stormwind's restored realm. Its stone mage tower survived the First War and the years of abandonment. The peaceful township around it is gone, and Twilight's Hammer zealots now occupy the secluded ruins. They use the once-prosperous valley for their own designs.

faq.answer: The Old Horde attacked and sacked Sunnyglade during the First War, enslaving its surviving residents. Human forces freed captive peasants and tried to rebuild, but Stormwind later abandoned the Riverglades to defend its homeland.
Twilight's Hammer cultists occupy Sunnyglade's ruins, including its broken houses and ancient wizard's tower.

faq.q: Why did the orcs leave the mage tower standing during the First War?
faq.answer: The Old Horde spared Sunnyglade's arcane tower so its warlocks and commanders could study human magic and seek to unravel its secrets.

faq.q: Why didn't Stormwind reclaim the town after the war?
faq.answer: Stormwind's leaders judged the Riverglades lost as the First War intensified and redirected military resources to defend the homeland, leaving Sunnyglade behind.

angles.text: As a mage, Sunnyglade's lone wizard's tower recalls early human spellcraft. The Old Horde spared it so they could study human arcane knowledge.
As a human, Sunnyglade's overgrown stones recall the outer settlements Stormwind abandoned when it pulled back during the First War.
